info.description: This API requires two authentication headers: X-Company-Login and X-Token. The X-Company-Login contains the company identifier and X-Token contains the authentication token received from the /public/auth/token endpoint.

get.description:
Returns everything the client needs to render the captcha widget before creating a booking.
Call it before POST /public/booking/item. If the response is { provider: null }, captcha is not
required for API bookings of this company. Otherwise:
1. load the script from widgetUrl (SBCaptcha universal widget);
2. render it: new SBCaptcha({ container: el, challenge: , onToken: fn });
3. send the token from onToken as captcha_token in the POST /public/booking/item body.
A token is single-use: fetch a new challenge after a failed booking.
The token is produced by the end user solving the widget, so integrations without a client-facing
UI cannot obtain it; the company can turn off "Enable captcha for API integrations" instead.

fetch('/public/captcha/challenge', { headers: { 'X-Company-Login': '...', 'X-Token': '...' } })
.then(r => r.json())
.then(data => new SBCaptcha({ container: el, challenge: data, onToken: fn }));

Response fields:
provider string Active provider: 'fcaptcha' | 'altcha' | 'recaptcha' | 'recaptchav3' | 'turnstile' | 'imagecaptcha' | null
widgetUrl string Absolute URL of the SBCaptcha widget loader script (captcha-widget.js)
assets object { js: string[], css: string[] } — scripts/styles to load before rendering.
For altcha and fcaptcha, JS URLs point to the public booking page proxy
(GET /v2/captcha/asset?file=) which serves the file with
Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * for cross-origin ES module loading.
site_key string reCAPTCHA public site key (recaptcha only)
imageUrl string PNG captcha image URL with cache-buster (imagecaptcha only)
challengeUrl string Absolute URL FCaptcha widget fetches sub-challenges from (fcaptcha only)
verifyUrl string Absolute URL FCaptcha widget POSTs PoW solution to (fcaptcha only)
verifyHeaders object Auth headers to include in the verifyUrl request (fcaptcha only;
SBCaptcha injects these automatically via fetch patch)
algorithm, challenge, maxnumber, salt, signature — Altcha challenge fields (altcha only)

If captcha is disabled for the company, returns { provider: null }.
Fail-open: if this endpoint is unreachable, proceed without captcha.

days.description:

For 'weekly' type: bitmask of week days. Sum the values for the days you need:
Sunday=1, Saturday=2, Friday=4, Thursday=8, Wednesday=16, Tuesday=32, Monday=64.
Example: Monday+Wednesday = 64+16 = 80.

type.description:

mode.description:

merge_candidate.description:
Set for a booking.page client that has no client record yet when exactly one existing
client has the same (verified) email: the client should be asked whether that account is
theirs and, if so, merged into it with POST /public/clients/merge before booking
